purpose: Tracks event-condition -> sector/ETF proxy delayed reactions. Use this for hypothesis discovery, not direct trade decisions.

conditions.news_risk_high: Collected news risk score is elevated.
conditions.macro_risk_high: Collected macro risk score is elevated.
conditions.market_context_high: Collected market context score is supportive.
conditions.energy_5d_up: Energy proxy XLE rose at least 3% over 5 trading days.
conditions.semis_5d_up: Semiconductor proxy SMH rose at least 4% over 5 trading days.
conditions.rates_sensitive_rebound: Homebuilders or real estate rebounded at least 3% over 5 trading days.
conditions.defensive_rotation: Utilities outperformed SPY by at least 2% over 20 trading days.
conditions.broad_risk_on_20d: SPY and QQQ both rose strongly over 20 trading days.
conditions.small_caps_5d_up: IWM rose at least 3% over 5 trading days.
